collection.description: A child imagines a carved servant pleading not to be dismantled, and asks whether its words could describe real pain.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child imagines a carved servant pleading not to be dismantled, and asks whether its words could describe real pain.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A healer argues that uncertainty should make people cautious about causing harm.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder fears that people might mistake imitation for suffering and neglect actual patients.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A researcher proposes comparing its words across different situations, while admitting that tests may not reveal inner experience.

text_only.reason: "experience" in its everyday sense (what a person has lived through), not a skill gain

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The child asks who gets to decide which answers count.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villagers agree not to mock the imagined plea.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A skeptic insists that compassion and evidence are different duties, both worth considering.
